description: Stadt Zürich (City of Zürich, Geomatik + Vermessung and Statistik Stadt Zürich) publishes a 3D roof model of the buildings of Zürich built on the footprints of the official cadastral survey with photogrammetrically determined roof structures (DXF, geodatabase, GeoPackage, CityGML for the whole city, WFS and WMS), and a companion dataset of 3D models of existing, approved and possible future high-rise buildings. Coverage: the City of Zürich; both portal records were last modified on 2026-09-29. Format and access: DXF, File geodatabase, GPKG, ZIP, WFS, WMS, WMTS, downloadable without registration from the City of Zürich open data portal; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons CCZero; cost: free. Caveats: the portal lists uses (noise mapping, visibility and shadow analysis, solar potential, visualisation) but no accuracy statement was read; the CityGML download is large and was not opened; the high-rise dataset mixes built, approved and speculative models distinguished by a status field. Simulation uses: 3D city models for urban digital twins, solar-potential and shadow studies, noise and wind modelling and flood-exposure analysis of buildings. Related catalogue records: Bauminventar (inkl. 3D), city-wide tree inventory with heights, Stadt Zürich (data-zurich-bauminventar-3d).
